messages.cli.help:
Plugins: plugins list/status [id|installed-path] | capabilities | guide plugins/ui | template cli/service/ui/guidance | inspect/install <path> | update <id|installed-path> <path> | enable/disable/remove <id|installed-path>
Manage plugins on the current Host. Installed tools are available after plugin.search and plugin.activate.
Configuration: instance | services | connections list/set/remove | models list/set/remove/default/probe
set takes --input <JSON file|->. connections set also accepts --api-key-file <file|->. Use --host-data-dir <instance data directory> to connect to one instance.
Model services: connections | auth login <connection-id|openai-codex> [browser|device] | auth status | auth logout <id> | quota <id> | usage [connection-id|all] [days]
usage defaults to all connections over the past 30 days, using UTC day boundaries. Enter 1–366 days. Example: achbit-cli usage all 7.
ask/chat accept --model <profile-id>. models set expects a full profile. connections set accepts {"connection":{...},"profile":{...}} with an optional profile. Read existing fields using the list commands before editing.
Supply keys via --api-key-file. models probe <profile-id> makes a live request and exits nonzero on failure. Offline help is available with help, -h or --help.
Achbit local coding agent

Usage:
  achbit-cli ask [-C <workspace>] [--session <id>] [--file <path>]... [--directory <path>]... [--plugin <plugin://uri>]... [--plain] <message-or-response>
  achbit-cli chat [-C <workspace>] [--session <id>] [--plugin <plugin://uri>]...
  achbit-cli sessions
  achbit-cli new [-C <workspace>]
  achbit-cli resume <full session: ID>
  achbit-cli show --session <id>
  achbit-cli read --session <id> [--view summary|messages|tools|plans|context|reasoning|images] [--before <sequence>] [--limit 1..50] [--record <id>] [--request <id>]
  achbit-cli cancel-plan --session <id>
  achbit-cli cancel --session <id> <run-id>
  achbit-cli attach-directory --session <id> <path>
  achbit-cli detach-directory --session <id> <workspace-id>
  achbit-cli open-resource --session <id> <workspace-id> <logical-path>
  achbit-cli diff --session <id> <record-id> <file-index>
  achbit-cli start-host
  achbit-cli stop-host
  achbit-cli status
  achbit-cli ssh help

Use -C/--workspace for a new conversation. Use attach-directory/detach-directory for an existing conversation.
In chat, /sessions lists sessions, /resume <number or full ID> opens one and /new uses the original working directory. Numbers refer to the last list in this process. Switching preserves background tasks and their permissions.
Send text at any time. An active run queues it. Use /reply 1 to confirm a plan, /reply <feedback> to request changes or answer a question, /reply 1/2 to allow/deny, and cancel-plan to cancel.
For multiple approvals use /reply --approval <approval-id> <decision>. When offered, /reply 3 allows matching commands for this run and /reply 4 allows Host Shell for this run. /permissions <JSON> changes permissions and /revoke <authority-id> revokes a grant.
Repeat --file and --directory with ask to select references. Image-capable models receive images. Other files remain read-only references.
Use --recipe <JSON file> to select the model, Loop components, permission policy and sandbox backend for a new session.
Repeat --plugin with ask/chat or let the agent discover enabled plugins. PDF input requires a configured PDF-capable skill. In chat, @ selects a plugin, /focus <task> focuses context, and /plan <task> requests a plan before execution.

messages.tui.help:
AC TUI

Usage:
  achbit-tui [-C <workspace>] [--session <id>] [--plugin <plugin://uri>]...
  achbit-tui [--language zh-CN|en-US] [--api <url>] [--no-auto-start-kernel] [--smoke]

--in-place keeps the current terminal; --font follow|warm|warm-sans|compact-kai|compact|system selects the dedicated window font on Windows.
--language overrides workbench.language; startup defaults to Simplified Chinese.
Use -C/--workspace to set the working directory for a new conversation.
--plugin is repeatable and selects plugins for the next request; type @ to open the same catalog.
Regular messages can be sent at any time and queue during a run; /reply 1 confirms a plan, /reply <text> revises a plan or answers a question; /reply 1/2 allows/denies an operation; /reply 3 allows host Shell for this run (when offered).
/cancel-plan cancels the plan; /cancel or Ctrl-C cancels the run; Esc clears input.
/plan <task> submits a plan for your confirmation before execution.
/focus <task> starts a task; /attach <path> attaches a directory; /detach <workspace-id> removes it; /model <profile> selects a model; /context shows context.
Type / to filter commands; ↑/↓ selects, Tab or Enter completes, then Enter executes; Esc dismisses suggestions.
/help lists all interactive commands.
/language en-US|zh-CN changes and saves the interface language during a session.
messages.tui.commandHelp:
AC commands

Type / to filter; ↑/↓ selects, Tab or Enter completes, then Enter executes.
Esc dismisses suggestions; recently used commands rank first in this window.

Sessions and models
/sessions List sessions (↑/↓, Enter to open, Esc to close)
/resume [number or full ID] Open a session; no argument shows the list
/new Start in the startup directory without cancelling the previous run
/model Choose connection and model; /model <profile> select a configured model
@ Select plugins for the next request
/font View and change the dedicated window font
/language en-US|zh-CN Change and save the interface language

Tasks and decisions
/plan <task> submits a plan for your confirmation before execution.
/focus <task> Start a task
/tasks View tasks
/agents View subagents; /agent <number or ID> enter, /back return
/decision Current decision details
/reply <text> Answer an interaction or revise a plan
/reply 1 Confirm a plan; /reply 1/2 allow/deny an operation
/reply 3 Allow host Shell for this run (when offered)
/cancel Cancel the run; /cancel-plan cancel the plan
Regular messages can queue at any time.

Files and execution details
/attach <path> Attach a directory
/detach <workspace-id> Remove a directory index
/open <workspace-id> <logical-path> Read a file; /next continue
/diff <record-id> <index> View changes
/tool <activity-id> Tool details
/reasoning Toggle reasoning details
/reasoning <request-id> [offset] Read reasoning on demand
/reasoning-history View reasoning history
/context View context; /show session information
/error Failure diagnostics and snapshot

Reading and input
PgUp / PgDn turn pages; mouse wheel scrolls the active view or picker
Shift+Enter adds a line (terminal support required); Enter sends pasted text
/close Return to conversation; /clear clear input; /quit exit

workbench.preventIdleSleep.label: Prevent idle sleep during tasks
workbench.preventIdleSleep.description: Keep the computer awake while tasks run. The display can still turn off. Turn this off to let the system manage sleep as usual.

gui.autoUpdate.label: Automatic updates
gui.autoUpdate.description: Check and download updates automatically, then install and restart when Achbit is idle. Activity in other apps does not delay updates. When disabled, check from About Achbit or click the ready update arrow to install.

gui.completionSound.foreground.label: Play completion sound in foreground
gui.completionSound.foreground.description: Off by default. Background tasks still play a sound and show a completion reminder.

gui.usageWidget.enabled.label: Usage widget
gui.usageWidget.enabled.description: Show costs or quota for the selected connection.

gui.usageWidget.currency.label: Cost currency
gui.usageWidget.currency.description: CNY estimates use a fixed rate of 1 USD = 7 CNY.

gui.defaultFileOpen.label: Open files with
gui.defaultFileOpen.description: Used for text links and file attachments, including HTML and PDFs. Images enlarge in this window; folders open in the system file manager.

gui.showRuntimeFiles.label: Show runtime files
gui.showRuntimeFiles.description: Show the runtime directory under Session files in the file tree.

gui.showContextRail.label: Show context rail
gui.showContextRail.description: Show tasks and outputs in the right sidebar.

workbench.styleTokenOverrides.label: Custom palette
workbench.styleTokenOverrides.description: Custom light and dark colors. Edit them in Appearance → Colors.

agent.minimalMode.label: Minimal mode (host execution without routine approval)
agent.minimalMode.description: New conversations use only file reading, writing, editing and shell commands. Plan, plugins and automatic titles are off. Shell commands run outside the workspace sandbox and still follow command rules.

agent.contextManagement.enabled.label: Automatic context management
agent.contextManagement.enabled.description: Compact history above the threshold when a task finishes or before the next run. May incur additional model charges. Turning this off does not disable context-limit compaction. Applies to the next run.

agent.contextManagement.thresholdTokens.label: Automatic compaction threshold (tokens)
agent.contextManagement.thresholdTokens.description: Default 500000 (500k); accepts a positive integer. Uses estimated current context, including cached input, not cumulative conversation usage.

agent.systemPrompt.label: System prompt
agent.systemPrompt.description: Appended to built-in instructions starting with the next main-agent task. Does not change a running task or apply to execution reviews or delegated agents.

agent.permissions.workspaceMutation.label: Plan
agent.permissions.workspaceMutation.description: Delegation uses an independent review context. Off omits Plans. Shell permissions remain separate.

agent.permissions.engineeringDecisions.label: Engineering decisions
agent.permissions.engineeringDecisions.description: Choose whether to ask you or let the Agent decide an unclear engineering approach. Missing requirements and out-of-workspace actions still require a question.

agent.permissions.networkRead.label: Public network read
agent.permissions.networkRead.description: Default permission for web search and reading public pages. Review for me evaluates each access and asks when uncertain.

agent.permissions.external.label: External actions
agent.permissions.external.description: Default permission for external tools. Review for me evaluates each operation and asks when uncertain. Shell has separate permission settings.

agent.web.search.endpointTemplate.label: Web Search Endpoint Override
agent.web.search.endpointTemplate.description: Leave empty for Brave search. A custom JSON HTTP endpoint must contain {query} and may include {limit}.

agent.web.search.authHeaderName.label: Web Search Auth Header
agent.web.search.authHeaderName.description: Authentication header for a custom search endpoint; Brave uses X-Subscription-Token.

agent.web.search.authSecretRef.label: Web Search Auth Secret
agent.web.search.authSecretRef.description: Search secret reference. Required for Brave; optional for custom endpoints.

skills.mounts.label: Project Skill Mounts
skills.mounts.description: JSON array of additional Skill mount definitions available to Agent runs. Skills under the workspace's .achbit/skills or .agents/skills are discovered automatically; mounts add other locations.

mcp.servers.label: Project MCP Servers
mcp.servers.description: JSON array of MCP service definitions available to Agent runs.

agent.permissions.shell.label: Execution approval
agent.permissions.shell.description: Review for me evaluates additional access or command execution for this call and asks when uncertain. Allow applies to Shell; other access follows its own settings.

agent.permissions.shellAccess.label: Execution scope
agent.permissions.shellAccess.description: Use full user privileges in the selected environment. Approval mode and command rules still apply.
